summary_en: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries authorized the acquisition of up to 120 million shares (3.6% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 300 billion yen through market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the 12-month period from November 9, 2026 to November 8, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled to improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries' Board of Directors authorized a share buyback program to acquire up to 120 million of the company's ordinary shares, representing 3.6% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of 300 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the 12-month period from November 9, 2026 through November 8, 2027.

All shares acquired under this program will be cancelled. The company stated that the cancellation will occur at the end of the quarter in which the acquisition is completed. The specific cancellation date will be announced once the acquisition is finalized and the completion date is determined.

The company cited capital efficiency improvement as the rationale for this share reduction program. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 3,968,465 treasury shares, with 3,369,679,345 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
